title: Jordan Canonical Form and the Minimal Polynomial

problemStatement.plain: What is the relationship between Jordan Canonical Form and the minimal polynomial of a linear endomorphism f : V → V? The minimal polynomial m_f(X) encodes the Jordan block structure: m_f(X) = ∏_{μ eigenvalue} (X - μ)^{e_μ} where e_μ is the size of the largest Jordan block for eigenvalue μ.
